identity.reused_photo_policy: Keep occurrence links as evidence; cropped, reframed, recompressed and watermarked versions can still be the same photograph. Cross-material scene reuse holds every disputed material sample until independent provenance resolves ownership.
identity.contextual_review: Preserve blind observations unchanged. After script comparison, Astra may reconcile generic metal ambiguity with explicit catalogue facts and inspect a clean crop. Save that contextual verdict separately. A photograph never certifies grade, coating thickness or an undocumented finish.

comparison.execution: Run 1 benchmark completed. Current production uses the metered company GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst API; accepted native outputs are reused.

sets.coverage: operator-approved explicit visual-family scope, with whole-catalogue backlog preserved

surface_macro.lighting: hard directional light, crisp highlights and deep contrast
surface_macro.anchor_feature: a distinctive feature of this exact section: corner radius, flange root, weld, raised tear, perforation
surface_macro.material: the verified material sample of this product type
surface_macro.publication: Private material-development evidence; excluded from the current public slideshow.

studio.reference: One reviewed image shared across every generated view and family; record its hash.
studio.lighting: Hard directional key from upper left, consistent exposure and white balance, controlled specular reflections, common shadow direction and softness.
studio.consistency: Compare the complete single-view delivery sheet across families. Material appearance may vary; the photographic studio stays fixed.

production.scope: One representative per evidenced section/material/finish combination. Grade-only changes may share when appearance is evidenced; distinct coatings and sections remain separate. Hardware needs its own product geometry or own-type source photo as structure.
production.lighting: Actual saved owner references and their descriptions control hard directional key, controlled specular lines, deep blacks, quiet grey studio and shallow macro focus. Brand adjectives are insufficient.
production.retry_policy: Set a bounded call budget before each batch; preserve rejected output and change a concrete physical clause or structural reference before retrying.
production.delivery: One individually judged angled product image per visual family. Validate source/export hashes and exact SKU mappings with pipeline.studio.delivery. Record studio reference hash, representative catalogue dimensions, provider usage, request ID and cost; reconcile provider invoice separately.

metering.settlement: usage-priced cost; provider invoice reconciliation separate

production.sales_checkpoint: Retain accepted sets; add specifically selected complex products. Stop metered generation at the approved scope or budget. Remaining catalogue photography is an onboarding stage, not an unfinished checkout feature.

geometry.trigger: User rejected inconsistent geometry, then rejected zoomed-out corrective framing

whole_piece.length: Choose a common purchasable stock length from the catalogue. Record millimetres and the selection reason. Short source samples establish finish, not stock length.
whole_piece.framing: Close product view. Long stock continues beyond the frame; one near end may establish section. Product scale comes from consistent proportions, not fitting its full length in frame.

source_roles.structural_render: One numerically defined part; authoritative geometry.
source_roles.material_crop: Surface class, colours and texture only.
source_roles.category_photo: Context; each individual variant needs an evidenced binding.

qa.before_generation: Inspect the neutral angled structure and its dimensions. Resolve variant bindings before generation.
qa.after_generation: Compare the generated angled image against its structural reference and the complete delivery against one studio anchor. Record specific gate verdicts and evidence.

geometry.cost_discipline: Stop on failed structure before spending. Generate one angled image per approved visual family. Retry only after a concrete correction within the batch budget.
